page.layout: No printed text blocks. The image shows the edge of a book: the text block is seen from its side between two pale limp covers (parchment or vellum), against a black background.
page.notes: The scan shows the book's edge and binding only, with no printed text, page number, running head, catchword or signature. The page block is closed, so the printed pages cannot be read from this view. The shadowed cut edges of the leaves are visible in the middle, but no lettering is.
